group_shape.representative: the image whose number and quality anchor the group

semantics: Reversible queue view: folding never writes images, labels or history.
Every member matched its representative directly; no transitive collapsing.
No folded member has input pixels identical to its representative: these are similar frames of the same scene or burst, not byte duplicates.
A similarity group is an engineering hint, not a confirmed capture sequence, and it never spans published splits.
To see a folded frame again, clear "Hide duplicates" in the annotator or use the Duplicates filter.
